THE PORTCULLIS HALF-RAISED: the heavy iron lattice gate, its portcullis bars half-raised, two small figures at the great wheel leaning hard on the spokes, one figure's boots lifting clear off the ground with the effort

THE BIG DOORS SWINGING WIDE: two small figures pushing the two great timber doors open from the inside, each figure reaching only to the bottom hinge of its door, both doors caught at the moment of swinging fully clear

THE DRAWBRIDGE COMING DOWN: the drawbridge tilting down with a small figure at the winch giving a last big crank, the far end of the bridge swinging toward the ground and still a full figure-height above it

THE LITTLE DOOR IN THE BIG DOOR: the small low door cut into the big timber door swinging open outward, a small figure stepping out through it with a lit lamp held high, the warm gold square of the doorway behind the figure

THE BELL RUNG HARD: a small figure in the arch hauling on the bell rope with both arms, the whole figure lifting clear of the ground as the rope pulls up, the bell above tilted at the top of its swing

THE CART WEDGED SIDEWAYS: a merchant's cart wedged sideways in the archway with its tall load leaning hard to the right, a scatter of small sprite figures waiting behind it and one guard plainly pretending not to notice from a post by the wall

THE HAY WAGON TOO TALL: a hay wagon a hand too tall for the arch with three small figures up on the load hauling the top sheaf free, the sheaf hanging half-pulled and about to come down on all of them
THE POTS SLIDING OFF: a big load of bright clay pots sliding half off a cart, a small figure diving forward with both arms out to catch the topmost pot before it reaches the ground

TWO CARTS NOSE TO NOSE: two carts met nose to nose inside the archway with neither backing up, the two small figures driving them both pointing at each other and a third small figure watching from the side

THE BARREL RUNNING FREE: a fat round barrel rolling fast across the paved ground in front of the gate, a small figure sprinting after it with both arms wide, the barrel already a full figure-length ahead
THE LAMPS HALF LIT: a guard with a long pole lighting the lamps along the wall, the near lamps burning gold and the far lamps still cold, the pole tip touching the wick of the last dark one
THE BASKET HAULED UP: a small figure on the wall walkway hauling a heavy basket up on a rope hand over hand, the basket swinging out from the wall a full arm-length below the figure and still rising

THE CHIMNEY CAUGHT: a fat white plume going straight up from the gatehouse chimney, a small figure on the walkway pointing at it and a second small figure below looking up with a hand shading both eyes

THE WATER SPOUT AFTER RAIN: water pouring hard from the high wall spout and splashing into the stone trough below, two small figures playing in the great white splash, arms wide and feet planted in the foam
THE BUCKET SLUICED: a small figure swinging a full bucket in a wide arc to sluice water across the stones under the arch, the sheet of water fanning out across the stones and still in the air

THE NEAREST TRAVELLER WAVING UP: a loose scatter of traveller figures reaching the paved ground in front of the gate, the nearest one a wide-hatted small sprite with both arms raised waving up at the wall walk above

THE CART ROLLING OUT: a loaded cart rolling out of the archway and turning away along the wall, a small figure at the reins leaning into the turn, the near wheel still catching the last of the arch shadow

THE TALL BIRD ARRIVING: a rider on a tall long-legged flightless bird coming up to the gate, the bird's long neck curving down and its head turning to look straight out at the viewer, the rider grabbing the neck to keep balance

THE FIGURE POINTING THE WAY: a small figure standing in the arch with one whole arm pointing out the road ahead for a traveller with a great pack, the traveller leaning forward with one foot already off the ground
THE FAMILY CART WAVED THROUGH: a guard waving a whole family's loaded cart through the gate with one big sweep of the arm while the other arm holds a half-eaten round of bread up at mouth level
THE SHUTTER FLUNG OPEN: a shutter flung fully open high in the gatehouse, a small figure leaning out of the bright warm room behind it with both arms spread wide across the frame of the window

THE LITTLE BASKET LOWERED: a small figure leaning over the parapet with a little round basket on a string, the basket swinging out past the wall face on its way down toward a second small figure standing below with hands cupped ready

THE LAUNDRY HAULED IN FAST: a long line of bright laundry strung between two towers being hauled in quickly, a small figure at each tower pulling the line, a fat knot of bunched cloth bunching up at the near tower top

THE ROPE DROPPED TO THE CART: a small figure on the wall walkway dropping a coiled rope down toward a small figure on a cart below, the rope caught mid-fall in a long loose loop still a full figure-height above the cart

THE BREAD HANDED UP ON A POLE: a small figure below holding a long pole with a tray of round loaves balanced on its flat end, a guard on the wall above leaning out over the parapet with both hands open ready to take it
